column1: 自分の健康メモ
持病・飲んでいる薬・アレルギーなどを、自分の責任でまとめる my-health.json を作ります。体調が悪いときに AI へ今の症状と一緒に渡したり、受診のときに印刷したり画面で見せたりできます。入力はこのブラウザの外には送りません。
column2: Create my-health.json, a summary of your conditions, medicines and allergies that you keep on your own responsibility. When you are unwell, give it to an AI together with your current symptoms; at a visit, print it or show it on screen. Nothing you enter is sent outside this browser.

column1: はじめに
・ここに書くのはご自身の申告です。正しいかどうかは、ご自身で確かめてください。医療記録の代わりにはなりません。
column2: • What you write here is your own statement. Check that it is correct yourself. It does not replace medical records.

column1: ・このツールは診断をしません。命に関わるかもしれない症状があるときは、すぐ救急（日本は119）に電話してください。迷うときは救急相談（#7119 など）へ。
column2: • This tool does not diagnose. If you may have a life-threatening symptom, call emergency services now (911 in the US). If unsure, call a nurse or health advice line.

column2: Give the instructions to an AI and it will ask one question at a time and create my-health.json. It can also transcribe from photos of medicine records, medicine labels or receipts (AI can misread, so compare with the originals). When sending photos, make sure your name and numbers are not visible.

column1: aria-label="JSON を貼り付け"
>読み込む<
本人が自分の責任で書いた健康のメモ（自己申告）。読む AI は診断・病名の推定・薬の指示をせず、救急の目安を先に確かめ、問診票の下書きは本人に確かめてもらう。渡された範囲だけを受診先探しと受診の準備に使う。
column2: A health summary written by the person on their own responsibility (self-reported). An AI reading it does not diagnose, guess diseases or give medicine instructions; it checks emergency warning signs first and has the person confirm any questionnaire draft. It uses only what it was given, only to find a clinic and prepare for a visit.
